## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve criterion preview dispatch, timeout-to-job fallback, and atomic overlay activation; editor validation, structured slice round-trip, transient-form isolation, unknown-key retention, and read-only effective-policy behavior; synchronous topological execution, recorder/idempotency seams, and the no-scheduler tripwire; gate topology/model/budget/provenance wiring; and recovery metrics, read-set, and fail-closed/degraded verdict shapes. Python docstrings have no __doc__/inspect.getdoc consumer in the pinned tree. Browser source comments are non-runtime; YAML schema directives and every non-comment workflow line remain exact. The editor build must leave committed dist artifacts unchanged.

Concise/load-bearing prose outside the allowlist stays byte-identical. So do runtime strings, assertions, fixtures, decorators, subprocess arguments, config values, and all 7 directive/shebang physical lines. Python uses the owner-docstring AST oracle. JS/JSX permits only full-line //, /*...*/, or JSX {/*...*/} prose blocks; added hunk lines must remain comment-only or blank. YAML permits only the listed comment regions/blank lines and requires ordered non-comment, non-blank lines to remain byte-identical.

## Verification and independent review
Parse base and final Python with `type_comments=True`; replace only allowlisted leading owner docstrings, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require the remaining AST/runtime tree to match. A zero-context base-to-final hunk guard restricts every deletion/insertion to an exact allowlisted base span. Run all six structured DD commands, including exact one-commit paths, focused consumers, scoped diff integrity, hygiene, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify`.

A reviewer who did not author the patch records a leaf-linked TSV with exactly 99 PASS rows, one per stable ID: `stable_id,before_citation,final_citation,preserved_contract_or_consumer,directives_exact,before_words,final_words,reviewer_session,semantic_pass,bloat_pass`. Every `final_words` is smaller; missing, extra, duplicate, or FAIL rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 99 allowlisted blocks have smaller final word counts.
- [ ] Non-allowlisted prose and all 7 directive/shebang lines remain exact.
- [ ] The immutable-base runtime/non-comment oracle passes for every owned file.
- [ ] Every preserved contract or consumer has an independent TSV PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the 11 declared paths and focused, diff-integrity, and hygiene checks exit 0.
- [ ] Untimed worktree-venv `make verify` exits 0.
